source.prompt: Nu-disco song, about 3.5 minutes, 117 BPM, Bb major. Glittering late-night city mood, playful and warm, a little nostalgic. Two bright female voices: a smooth lead with close female harmonies on the pre-chorus and chorus, call-and-response lines in the bridge. Funky slap bass, muted funk guitar, lush string section, short brass stabs, warm Rhodes electric piano chords, soft analog synth pad. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, 16th hats, tambourine. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Ooh, ooh, ah

[Verse]
Streetlights blinking in a silver line
Your hand is warm and the night is mine
We slip the crowd through a velvet door
Shoes in our hands on the marble floor

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, don't slow it down
Every heartbeat makes a sound

[Chorus]
We're chasing silver hours
Spinning under city towers
Hold me till the morning flowers
Chasing silver hours

[Verse 2]
Taxi windows painted gold and blue
Every song on the radio is new
Laughing loud on the empty street
The bassline moving underneath our feet

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, don't slow it down
Every heartbeat makes a sound

[Chorus]
We're chasing silver hours
Spinning under city towers
Hold me till the morning flowers
Chasing silver hours

[Bridge]
Call my name (call my name)
Light the flame (light the flame)
We don't need a reason
Let the moon do the leading

[Final Chorus]
We're chasing silver hours
Spinning under city towers
Hold me till the morning flowers
Chasing silver hours
Oh, chasing silver hours

[Outro]
Ooh, ooh, silver hours
